verdict.rationale: three.js is itself the official SDK: an MIT-licensed npm package (v0.186.0, about 12M weekly downloads, verified by a runtime probe) with documented first-party APIs such as WebGLRenderer, WebGPURenderer, TSL node materials, loaders and controls. An llms.txt with explicit LLM instructions makes it a practical target for AI-native coding. missing for 10: officially maintained TypeScript typings (community @types/three has signature mismatches the maintainer won't fix), SDK coverage beyond JavaScript.
